name: mirage
text: Result from PropLine's free book-accuracy report (90 days, about 1.2M graded props). No book is the sharpest everywhere. On MLB props Pinnacle is slightly WORSE than the field (it lost 4.5 basis points of Brier score against the average of the other books; the range excludes zero), and Kalshi is the best. On NBA props Novig is best, but on MLB and NFL props it trails. On NHL props nobody beats the field. What this means for Vigilant: treating Pinnacle as the sharp reference for props is shakier than I assumed, so books should be weighted per sport and bet type by this skill, not by name. I haven't changed any setting yet. I need our own CLV by book to agree first, and I'm handing this to the star-rating study. The write-up is research/propline_book_accuracy_2026-10-24.md.
